question: What kind of person is disqualified by lacking devotion to kula and guru?
premises: Devotion to kula may be absent
Devotion to guru may be absent
Both absences characterize the same person
inference: A person devoid of devotion to both kula and guru is indicated as unfit.
plain_english: But in one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
